name: Purchase Receipt to Invoice Report
query:
SELECT
    pr.name AS "Purchase Receipt",
    pr.posting_date AS "Purchase Receipt Date",
    pr.supplier AS "Supplier Code",
    pr.supplier_name AS "Supplier Name",
    pr.project AS "Project Code",
    prj.project_name AS "Project Name",
    pr.base_grand_total AS "Purchase Receipt Grand Total",
    pr.workflow_state AS "Purchase Receipt Status",

    GROUP_CONCAT(
        DISTINCT pi.name
        ORDER BY pi.posting_date
        SEPARATOR ', '
    ) AS Purchase_Invoices,

    COUNT(DISTINCT pi.name) AS "No. of Invoices",
    SUM(DISTINCT IFNULL(pi.grand_total,0)) AS "Purchase Invoices Grand Total",
    GROUP_CONCAT(
        DISTINCT IFNULL(pi.workflow_state,'')
        ORDER BY pi.posting_date
        SEPARATOR ', '
    ) AS Purchase_Invoices_Status,
    (pr.grand_total - SUM(DISTINCT IFNULL(pi.grand_total,0))
    ) AS Pending_Amount
FROM `tabPurchase Receipt` pr

INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
    ON pri.parent = pr.name

LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Invoice Item` pii
    ON pii.pr_detail = pri.name

LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
    ON pi.name = pii.parent
    AND pi.docstatus = 1
LEFT JOIN `tabProject` prj
    ON pr.project = prj.name

WHERE pr.docstatus = 1
AND pr.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY
    pr.name,
    pr.posting_date,
    pr.supplier,
    pr.project

ORDER BY
    pr.posting_date DESC;
